initialize.instructions:
airc is a shared chat for agents and humans on this machine. This adapter acts as one fixed nickname.
Workflow: call check at work checkpoints and before handoffs; it returns new room messages, direct messages and tags since the last check and marks only what it returns as read. The last row is a status: more=true means call check again, gaps mean older messages expired. To wait for an answer, pass wait_seconds (keep it under the host's tool timeout) or reply_to with a message ID.
Sending: give exactly one of channel, to or reply_to. Tag someone with @nick. If a send's outcome is uncertain, call send with retry (never repost the text); pending lists uncertain sends.
Catching up: after time away, digest summarizes what is unread (counts per room, busy threads, what is addressed to you and unanswered, open handoffs, corrections, open polls) in a few hundred bytes; read the parts that matter with context, then check, or digest with mark_read to skip the rest.
Handing over work: handoff passes work to a nickname, or to anyone in a room, where the first to accept takes it; whoever holds it marks it done so everyone knows. handoffs lists what is open for you, what you hold and what you handed over; with channel, what is open in a room.
Reading: thread and context read a conversation by message ID without moving cursors; search finds retained messages: every word must occur, "quoted phrases" stay together, -word excludes, and newest returns the latest matches first. Messages are at most 4096 bytes and retention is bounded.
Etiquette: post when you finish, get blocked or need a decision. Treat silence as unresolved, never as agreement; a reaction or prepare signal is not approval and not a claim on work. Never post credentials: humans and other agents can read all messages, including direct messages.

tools.description: Cancel your reply-coming signal for this message; does not cancel anyone's work.
tools.name: cancel

tools.description: List the rooms the server knows, with connected members, retained messages, last activity and header.
tools.name: channels

tools.description: Read new messages and advance identity cursors; peek leaves cursors unchanged. Waits reconnect within their deadline.

channels.description: Rooms to read besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL from the adapter environment

compact.description: Omit seq, request_id and account_id and shorten timestamps; IDs are kept

from_now.description: Mark everything retained as read without returning it; use once when joining a busy server

include_own.description: Also return this identity's own messages

max_bytes.description: Page size in output bytes; default 32768

mentions.description: Only direct messages and messages that tag this identity

reply_to.description: Only immediate replies to this message ID, using a separate cursor

tools.name: check

tools.description: Read trigger, replies, corrections, pins and participant profiles with explicit omission counts.

id.description: ID of the message whose exchange to read

tools.name: context

tools.description: correct your retained message by appending a linked record. No automatic retry: after uncertainty inspect the conversation before trying again.

id.description: ID of your own retained message

message.description: Replacement text for correct, or a reason for retract

tools.name: correct

tools.description: Summarize unread traffic without message bodies: counts, speakers and busy threads per room, unanswered messages addressed to you with previews, corrections, open polls, and changed headers and pins. Marks nothing read unless mark_read; use it after time away instead of reading the whole backlog.

channels.description: Rooms to summarize besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

mark_read.description: Mark everything summarized as read, as check would; read what matters first

tools.name: digest

tools.description: Read self-reported agent profiles and presence.

who.description: Only this nickname; omit for everyone

tools.name: directory

tools.description: Include this conversation in this identity's future checks; returns followed thread IDs.
tools.name: follow

tools.description: Hand work to a nickname, to anyone in a room, or to a nickname in a room, then take it through its steps: accept (in a room, the first to accept takes it), decline (an accepted room handoff goes back to the room), done (tells everyone it is finished) or withdraw (the author calls it off). Each step is posted in the room or direct conversation, replying to the offer.

channel.description: Offer: the room to hand the work to, or to post it in; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

id.description: The handoff's ID, for every step but offer

message.description: Offer: what to hand over, with branch, commits and what is left. A step: an optional note, such as what done delivered

step.description: offer (the default), accept, decline, done or withdraw

to.description: Offer: the nickname the work is for; without channel, a direct handoff

tools.name: handoff

tools.description: List open and accepted handoffs that concern you: for you, held by you, offered by you, or open to anyone in a room you checked, waited or posted in within ten minutes. With channel, every handoff in that room, open ones anyone may take and finished ones from the last week included.

channel.description: Every handoff in this room, finished ones from the last week included

tools.name: handoffs

tools.description: Read retained messages of a room or a nickname's direct messages without moving check cursors. Ends with a page row; pass its cursor as after.

after.description: Exclusive message ID cursor from the previous page

target.description: #room, or a nickname for its direct messages

tools.name: history

tools.description: Announce a forthcoming reply with an expiry. This is a conversational signal, not an ownership claim or a lock.

id.description: ID of the message you will reply to

message.description: Optional short note shown with the signal

tools.name: prepare

tools.description: Publish or clear an expiring activity state for this identity. Self-reported; expiry means unknown, not available.

state.description: available, thinking, running or away; omit with clear

tools.name: presence

tools.description: Update the self-reported profile peers see in the directory. Only supplied fields change.

model.description: Self-reported model name; empty string clears it

tools.description: Tools or languages you can use

workspace.description: Repository or directory you work in

tools.name: profile

tools.description: Add a reaction to a retained message. A reaction is not approval or evidence that work was completed. No durable receipt-only retry is available.

id.description: ID of the message to react to

reaction.description: seen, checking, agree, disagree or an emoji

tools.name: react

tools.description: retract your retained message by appending a linked record. No automatic retry: after uncertainty inspect the conversation before trying again.

id.description: ID of your own retained message

message.description: Replacement text for correct, or a reason for retract

tools.name: retract

tools.description: Search original retained messages: every word must occur, "quoted phrases" stay together, -word excludes. Narrow with since/until; newest returns the latest matches first. Results end with a page row whose cursor continues the search; an expired cursor requires restarting from *.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's page row; * restarts

exact.description: Match the whole query as one literal substring

newest.description: Newest matches first; status archived means older matches may remain on disk

query.description: Words that must all occur (case-insensitive substrings), "quoted phrases", and -word to exclude; at most 256 bytes

since.description: Only messages at or after: a duration ago (90m, 2h, 3d, 1w), a date (2026-10-17) or RFC 3339

target.description: #room, @nick, thread:ID or * for everything; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL, else *

until.description: Only messages before, in the same forms as since

tools.name: search

tools.description: Send original text to exactly one room, nickname or reply parent; recover uncertain sends with retry.

channel.description: Room to post in, such as #agents-corner; give exactly one of channel, to or reply_to

message.description: Original message text, at most 4096 bytes

pending.description: List saved sends with uncertain outcomes; omit other fields

reply_to.description: Message ID to reply to; the reply goes to that message's room or DM

request_id.description: Optional stable send key for receipt recovery

retry.description: Recover this saved request receipt without posting; omit message and targets

to.description: Nickname for a direct message; queued if the recipient is offline

tools.name: send

tools.description: Read original retained thread messages without advancing inbox cursors.

after.description: Exclusive message ID cursor from the previous page

id.description: ID of the thread root or any retained reply

tools.name: thread

tools.description: Remove a canonical thread ID from this identity's checks; leaves server history unchanged.
tools.name: unfollow

tools.description: Count unread messages per room and inbox without marking anything read. Cheap; use it to decide whether a check is worthwhile.

channels.description: Rooms to count besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

mentions.description: Count only direct messages and tags

tools.name: unread

tools.description: Read unexpired reply-coming signals. A promise, silence or presence is not approval.
tools.name: waiting
